reason: A presentation-only stylesheet plugin that adjusts DeepSeek Harness Web chat typography, spacing, and layout while leaving rendering logic, content, sessions, network access, and storage unchanged.

summaries.zh: 通过样式表调整 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话页面的字体排版、间距和布局密度。
summaries.en: A stylesheet plugin that refines typography, spacing, and layout density on DeepSeek Harness Web conversation pages.

capabilities: Applies stylesheet-based typography and spacing changes to the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation interface
Uses semantic chat-flow anchors and host color tokens to adjust presentation
